title: DOW-UAP-D62, Mission Report, Strait of Hormuz, September 2020
doc_notes: This document is a declassified Mission Report (MISREP) from the U.S. Air Force detailing operations in the Strait of Hormuz on September 16, 2020, which includes a brief mention of a UAP observation recorded via Full Motion Video (FMV).

incidents.summary: A U.S. military operator reported observing one UAP at an estimated altitude of 1,800 feet.
